---
title: "Share and publish"
description: "Step 5 of the TVB-O spine: publish a study to the platform and export its results in community formats."
aliases:
  - /phases/share.html
---

A study that only runs on your machine is not reproducible, it is merely repeatable. The last step closes that gap: publish the specification so someone else can reference it by IRI, and export the results in formats other tools already read.

Because the specification *is* the experiment, sharing it shares everything — the equations, the connectome reference, the integrator settings, the observation model and the figures — rather than a snapshot of numbers whose provenance has to be reconstructed.
